scripts.dev:android: node scripts/check-skymess-updates.mjs && echo 🔧 Building web app... && pnpm --filter @atc-app/app build && echo 🔄 Syncing with Capacitor... && pnpm --filter @atc-app/mobile exec cap sync android && echo 🏗️ Building Android APK... && cd packages/mobile/android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug && echo 📲 Installing APK... && adb install -r app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk && echo 🚀 Launching app... && adb shell am start -n com.atcapp.app/com.atcapp.app.MainActivity
scripts.dev:ios: node scripts/check-skymess-updates.mjs && pnpm --filter @atc-app/app build && pnpm --filter @atc-app/mobile exec cap sync ios && cd packages/mobile/ios/App && xcodebuild -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15' -derivedDataPath build && xcrun simctl install booted build/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/App.app && xcrun simctl launch booted com.atcapp.app
scripts.dev:mobile: node -e "const os=require('os'); const isMac=os.platform()==='darwin'; console.log(isMac ? '🍏 Running iOS build...' : '🤖 Running Android build...'); const {execSync}=require('child_process'); execSync(isMac ? 'pnpm run dev:ios' : 'pnpm run dev:android', {stdio:'inherit'});"
scripts.mobile:clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const del=p=>{if(fs.existsSync(p)){console.log('🧹 Removing',p);fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});}};['packages/app/dist','packages/mobile/android/app/src/main/assets/public','packages/mobile/android/build','packages/mobile/android/app/build','packages/mobile/ios/App/App/public'].forEach(d=>del(path.resolve(d)));console.log('✅ Clean complete.');"
scripts.build:mobile:android: cross-env CAPACITOR_PLATFORM=android pnpm --filter @atc-app/app exec vite build
scripts.build:mobile:ios: cross-env CAPACITOR_PLATFORM=ios pnpm --filter @atc-app/app exec vite build
scripts.android:dev: pnpm run build:mobile:android && pnpm run cap:sync:android && echo '✅ Android sync complete'
scripts.android:release: pnpm run mobile:clean && pnpm run build:mobile:android && pnpm run cap:sync:android && cd packages/mobile/android && (./gradlew assembleRelease || gradlew.bat assembleRelease) && echo '✅ Android release APK complete'
scripts.ios:release: pnpm run build:mobile:ios && pnpm --filter @atc-app/mobile exec cap sync ios && cd packages/mobile/ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -archivePath ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/Archives/ATC-APP/App.xcarchive archive && echo ✅ Archive complete
scripts.android:bundle: pnpm run mobile:clean && pnpm run build:mobile:android && pnpm run cap:sync:android && cd packages/mobile/android && (./gradlew bundleRelease || gradlew.bat bundleRelease) && echo '✅ Android release AAB complete'
scripts.mobile:build:release: node -e "const os=require('os'); const isMac=os.platform()==='darwin'; console.log(isMac ? '🍏 Building iOS...' : '🤖 Building Android...'); const {execSync}=require('child_process'); execSync(isMac ? 'pnpm run ios:release' : 'pnpm run android:release', {stdio:'inherit'});"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p packages/electron/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/mobile/tsconfig.json
scripts.setup:dev: echo 🧩 Starting ATC-APP Dev Setup... && pnpm verify:env && pnpm install && pnpm mobile:clean && pnpm --filter @atc-app/app build && pnpm --filter @atc-app/mobile exec cap sync && echo ✅ ATC-APP project is ready for development!
scripts.release: pnpm run verify:env && pnpm run build && pnpm run dist:electron && pnpm exec standard-version
scripts.release:minor: pnpm run verify:env && pnpm run build && pnpm run dist:electron && pnpm exec standard-version --release-as minor
scripts.release:major: pnpm run verify:env && pnpm run build && pnpm run dist:electron && pnpm exec standard-version --release-as major
scripts.release:all: pnpm run release && pnpm run android:bundle && pnpm run ios:release
scripts.release:all:minor: pnpm run release:minor && pnpm run android:bundle && pnpm run ios:release
scripts.release:all:major: pnpm run release:major && pnpm run android:bundle && pnpm run ios:release
